summary: Wiz6's UI renders text as a TILE GRID, not via glyph+attribute composition. Each tile-mode window owns a 2-byte-per-cell back-store array of (char, attr) pairs in heap; the screen-blit routine (wroot 0x12b19) walks each cell and dispatches to ega.drv slot 1 (4bpp text putchar at 0x43a), which blits an 8x8 4bpp planar glyph from the wfont*.ega selected by attr's low nibble (1=wfont1, 2=wfont2, 3=wfont3, 4=wfont4). EVERY pixel of every tile is fully defined — there is NO transparency, NO attribute-based recoloring, NO bg/fg compositing. To draw 'colored text' the artist made multiple visually-equivalent shape variants at different ASCII codepoints, each pre-painted in the desired color scheme: e.g. wfont3 0x41..0x5A are uppercase letters BLU-on-DGY (for menu_text panel), and 0x61..0x7A are the SAME shapes but LBL-on-BLK with black top/bottom rows (for banner row's 1px-line effect). The 'gray menu pane background' is just slot 0x20 of wfont3 (a uniform DGY 8x8 fill tile) replicated across every cell of the menu_text_window. Pixel-mode windows (flags & 2: gate, top_title, full_bg) bypass the tile grid entirely and use the f130/f148/f10c pixel-direct primitives — that's where mon08.PIC sprites and dragonsc.ega land. The tile grid is text-mode-only; pixel-mode windows are pixel-mode-only.
key_insight: wfont*.ega files are spritesheets of 8x8 tiles; cells of a 40x25 grid are filled by blitting one tile per cell. No transparency. Different colors = different tile slots. The attribute byte's low nibble (1..4) selects which wfont1-4 file. wfont0 (1bpp) is a separate path used by other primitives (not main UI). 'Different visual styles' (panel-letters with gray edges vs banner-letters with black edges) are achieved by encoding the SAME letter shape twice in different slots with different baked colors, then choosing between them by varying the ASCII codepoint of the source string — uppercase ASCII lands on panel-variant glyphs (0x41..0x5A), lowercase lands on banner-variant glyphs (0x61..0x7A).
method: Static disassembly with ndisasm of wroot.exe (image base 0x10000, MZ header 0x200) and ega.drv (flat binary), focused on (1) ui_window_clear (wroot 0x132be / file 0x32be), (2) ui_window_puts (wroot 0x1251d / file 0x251d), (3) ui_window_putchar (wroot 0x123e3 / file 0x23e3), (4) ui_centered_text (wroot 0x10b7e / file 0xb7e), (5) ui_window_create (wroot 0x1011a / file 0x11a), (6) blit_dirty_cells (wroot 0x12b19 / file 0x2b19), (7) ega.drv slot 1 text 4bpp (offset 0x43a), (8) ega.drv slot 0 text 1bpp (offset 0x19a), (9) ega.drv slot 13 fill_rect (offset 0x735), and (10) wroot's load_font_or_portrait (0x121bb / file 0x21bb) which keys font segment loads off font_index=0..4. Tile-content characterization done by decoding all 128 slots of all 5 wfont files (Python plane-decoder, matches docs/re/wfont-4bpp.md format spec) and grouping by edge-color signature to identify panel vs banner variants. Equivalence between uppercase/lowercase glyph shapes verified by comparing the foreground-bit pattern between slot pairs (0x41,0x61), (0x4D,0x6D), (0x42,0x62), (0x5A,0x7A) — all MATCH.

tile_mode.struct_layout: 20-byte header + (w_cells * h_cells * 2) byte cell array at offset 0x10
tile_mode.cell_format: 2 bytes per cell: byte 0 = char (font slot index), byte 1 = attr (low nibble = font selector 1..4)
tile_mode.draw_path: ui_window_clear / ui_window_puts WRITE TO CELL ARRAY ONLY; the global blit (wroot 0x12b19) later walks each cell, looks at attr's low nibble, and calls ega.drv slot 1 (4bpp text putchar at ega.drv 0x43a) with ah=attr_lo, al=char to rasterize the 8x8 4bpp planar glyph from the selected wfont into the back-buffer at the cell's screen coords.

pixel_mode.draw_path: f130 fill_rect (raw byte to all 4 planes), f148 sprite_by_id (PIC atlas blit), f10c pic_descriptor (PIC compositor) all write DIRECTLY to the shared pixel back-buffer at [ega.drv cs:0x14d]. NO tile grid. NO font dispatch. Sprites use the standard PIC nibble permutation.

tile_dispatch_chain.effect: writes (char=0x20, attr=3) to every cell of menu_text_window's 40x5 cell array
for each byte b in string: call ui_window_putchar(handle, b, 3) which writes (b, 3) to cell at current cursor and advances cursor +1 cell
triggers wroot blit (0x12b19) for each dirty window

tile_dispatch_chain.call: per-cell loop over window's cell array
tile_dispatch_chain.effect: load (char, attr) word; mask attr to get low nibble; cmp 1/2/3/4; dispatch to ega.drv slot 1 via [cs:0x1b8e] far-pointer with ah=attr_lo_nibble, al=char

si = char * 32 (glyph offset); ds = font_segment selected by ah via dec/jz chain (ah=1 -> wfont1 seg, ah=2 -> wfont2, ah=3 -> wfont3, ah=4 -> wfont4); for plane p in 0..3: program EGA sequencer port 0x3C4 reg 2 with plane_mask=1<<p; rep movsb 8 bytes from font[si + p*8] into back-buffer at di, stepping di by 0x27=39 between scanlines (so 1 byte written + 39 stride = 40-byte row stride)

attribute_to_font_map.engine_dispatch_in_ega_drv_slot_1: dec ah / jz chain at ega.drv 0x453..0x46e
attribute_to_font_map.blit_dispatch_in_wroot: wroot 0x2c33..0x2c5c — masks attr by 0x0f, compares against 1, 2, 3, 4; falls through to abort path (int 21 ah=9, ah=4c) if low nibble in 5..F; takes empty-cell path via [cs:0x1b8a] if low nibble == 0
attribute_to_font_map.ui_window_clear_attr_3: wbase ed5a(menu_text_handle, 0x20, 3, 0) — attr=3 -> wfont3 -> slot 0x20 of wfont3 (uniform DGY) blitted to every cell. This is HOW the menu pane gets its gray background.
attribute_to_font_map.ui_window_puts_attr_3: wbase dfb9(handle, str, 3) for menu option labels -> wfont3, uppercase ASCII letters land on slots 0x41..0x5A (BLU-on-DGY panel-variant)
attribute_to_font_map.ui_centered_text_attr_0x12: wbase c61a(banner, str, 0, 0x12) — c61a checks if attr >= 0x10: yes, so calls ui_window_puts with attr = 0x12 - 0xF = 3. Same wfont3 file as menu text. The DIFFERENCE in visual style comes from the SOURCE STRING using lowercase ASCII codes (0x61..0x7A) which land on the banner-variant glyphs in wfont3 (LBL-on-BLK with BLK top/bottom rows for the 1-pixel separator effect). The string 'MASTER OPTIONS' in msg.dbs ID 0x3E9 is likely encoded as lowercase 'master options'.
attribute_to_font_map.highlight_path_attr_minus_5: wbase df85(handle, buf, 0xFFFB=-5) for the selected menu item — wroot 0x22b7 (highlight putchar variant) tests sign bit, negates if set, then SHIFTS attr LEFT by 4 to store it in the HIGH nibble of the cell word (not low). The blit then sees attr_lo_nibble == 0 and takes the '[cs:0x1b8a]' empty-cell path — a DIFFERENT rendering primitive that uses the HIGH nibble. This is likely an inverse-video / XOR-fill path for showing the cursor highlight on the selected menu option.

ui_window_create (0x1011a / file 0x11a).behavior: If flags & 2: allocate 20-byte struct only (pixel-mode window). Else: allocate 20-byte header + w*h*2 bytes for cell array.

ui_window_set_cursor (0x1030b / bda7 thu.behavior: Writes x_cell to [handle+6], y_cell to [handle+7]. Cursor is per-cell, not per-pixel.

ui_window_putchar (0x123e3 / file 0x23e3.behavior: Stores packed word (al=char, ah=attr_lo_byte) at cell offset [handle + 0x10 + (cursor_y * w + cursor_x) * 2]. Then advances cursor: cursor_x++; if cursor_x >= w: cursor_x=0, cursor_y++; if cursor_y >= h: cursor_y=0 (wraps both directions, no scroll). No special handling for CR/LF/control codes — every byte (including 0x00..0x1F) is stored as a tile index verbatim.
ui_window_putchar (0x123e3 / file 0x23e3.note: Calls a 'mark dirty' helper via far call cs:0x1b8e (also used by the per-cell blit).

ui_window_puts (0x1251d / file 0x251d /.behavior: Loops: load byte at str_ptr; if zero, stop. Else call ui_window_putchar(handle, byte, attr); advance str_ptr. No word-wrap logic — relies on caller-set cursor + fixed-width string fitting in the window.

ui_window_clear (0x132be / file 0x32be /.behavior: Resets cursor to (0,0). Computes cell_count = w * h. Loads di = [handle + 0x10]. If [bp+8] (the 3rd arg = 'attr_or_0') is nonzero: ah = al (use bp+8 as attr). Else: ah = (bp+0xa) << 4 (use 4th arg shifted up). al = char. rep stosw — fill all cells with the packed (char, attr) word.
ui_window_clear (0x132be / file 0x32be /.wbase_call: ed5a(menu_text_handle, 0x20, 3, 0) -> char=0x20, attr=3, fills 5*40=200 cells with (0x20, 3).

ui_centered_text (0x10b7e / file 0xb7e /.behavior: len = strlen(str); x_cell = 20 - (len+1)/2; ui_window_set_cursor(handle, x_cell). Then: if attr >= 0x10: call ui_window_puts(handle, str, attr - 0xF). Else: call a DIFFERENT puts variant at wroot 0x124e9 (df85 thunk) with the raw attr (highlight path).
ui_centered_text (0x10b7e / file 0xb7e /.wbase_call: c61a(banner, str, 0, 0x12) -> centers and calls ui_window_puts(banner, str, 3) -> wfont3.

blit_dirty_cells (wroot 0x12b19 / file 0.behavior: For each cell (h*w iterations): load packed (char, attr) word; clear dirty bit; mask attr's low nibble; cmp 1/2/3/4; if matched, far-call [cs:0x1b8e] (ega.drv slot 1 = 4bpp text putchar at 0x43a) with ah=attr_lo, al=char, di=screen_offset. If low nibble == 0: take empty-cell path via [cs:0x1b8a]. Else if 5..F: abort via int 21 ah=9 (print error msg) + ah=4c (exit).

ega.drv slot 1 (text putchar 4bpp at 0x4.behavior: bx = char << 5 = char * 32 (4bpp glyph offset). dx = [cs:0x159+(font_sel-1)*4] = font segment selected by ah via dec/jz chain. ds:si = font_seg:glyph_offset. For each plane 0..3: out 3C4, 2; out 3C5, 1<<plane; rep movsb 8 bytes (1 byte per scanline) from font[si + plane*8] to es:di, with di += 0x27 between scanlines (40-byte row stride: 1 byte written + 39 stride).

ega.drv slot 0 (text putchar 1bpp at 0x1.behavior: bx = char << 3 = char * 8 (1bpp glyph offset). Reads wfont0 (1024 bytes, 8 bytes per glyph). NOT USED by main UI — likely a fallback or debug path.
ega.drv slot 0 (text putchar 1bpp at 0x1.note: wfont0 contents are all monochrome BLU-on-BLK letters/numbers/symbols (verified). Not used by the main menu's ui_window_puts/clear/centered_text dispatch chain.

ega.drv slot 13 (f130 fill_rect at 0x735.behavior: Writes fill_byte to ALL 4 EGA planes for the window's pixel rect. Only colors 0 (all planes 0) and 0xF (all planes 0xFF) are reachable. NOT TILE-BASED. Used by pixel-mode windows (flags & 2).
ega.drv slot 13 (f130 fill_rect at 0x735.wbase_call: f130(*0x4fbc=0x73FA gate window, 0) -> blackens the gate back-buffer before sprite composition.

ega.drv slot 14 (f13c blit_window_to_scr.behavior: Commits the window's back-buffer to A000:0 via the EGA sequencer. Per-plane plane_mask write.

ega.drv slot 15 (f148 sprite_by_id at 0x.behavior: Resolves sprite via the cs:0x190+5*id atlas record; blits PIC-format sprite glyph to back-buffer with OR-blend (mode=0) or opaque (mode!=0). Pixel-level write to all 4 planes (PIC permutation applied).

y=0..24 x=16..304.render_mode: PIXEL — dragonsc.ega 'Wizardry' decorative stripe rendered by winit state 2 (left over). Not redrawn by wbase. f13c-refreshed each menu loop iter.

y=24..32 x=0..320.render_mode: PIXEL — whatever was in the shared back-buffer; likely BLACK from initial state.

y=32..144 x=72..248.render_mode: PIXEL — FUN_07b7 each animation tick: f130 black-fill, 12 opaque sprite blits (mon08 castle gates), 4 OR-blend overlays, 6 pic-descriptor renders (columns/water), +2 parity-gated water sprites.
y=32..144 x=72..248.tile_grid: NONE — entire region is pixel-composited from mon08.PIC sprites.

y=32..144 x=8..64.render_mode: TILE GRID via cell array. Border glyphs (1B/1C heavy frame) + portrait/stat cells.
y=32..144 x=8..64.tile_grid: 7x12 = 84 cells. Each cell is an 8x8 tile from a wfont, selected by attr's low nibble. Border tiles come from wfont1 (or similar) frame primitives.

y=32..144 x=256..312.tile_grid: Symmetric to party_left with attr=0x07 = wfont... per low nibble = wfont7? Out of range. Possibly attr=0x07 high bit changes behavior; needs further trace.

y=144..152 x=0..320.render_mode: TILE GRID. c61a(banner, str_lowercase, 0, 0x12) → puts with attr=3 → wfont3 banner-variant glyphs.
y=144..152 x=0..320.tile_grid: 40 cells x 1 row. The centered text 'master options' (lowercase ASCII) renders at the center. Cells OUTSIDE the centered region retain whatever was previously in the cell array — for the first-ever frame this is likely zeros (empty-cell render path), but on subsequent frames it's whatever the previous iteration left there. The 1-pixel black separator effect at top/bot of the banner row is encoded directly in the banner-variant glyphs (top row + bot row of each 8x8 cell is all-BLK).
y=144..152 x=0..320.open_question: Are the cells outside the centered text explicitly cleared to slot 0x5F (banner-space) before the centered text is written? Need to check if c497/ebb4 do an implicit clear, or if the banner cells are pre-filled by winit state 2 with 0x5F-attr-3. (TENTATIVE: based on the visual 1-px line effect spanning the FULL row width, the cells outside the text MUST be banner-variant tiles, most likely 0x5F.)

y=152..192 x=0..320.window: menu_text 0x7426 (40x5 cells, flags=0, attr=0x0F) — TRANSIENT per loop iter
y=152..192 x=0..320.render_mode: TILE GRID. ed5a(handle, 0x20, 3, 0) fills with wfont3 slot 0x20 (uniform DGY) -> THIS IS THE GRAY PANEL BACKGROUND. Then dfb9 writes uppercase ASCII text into cells in a 3-column 4-row grid -> wfont3 panel-variant letters (BLU-on-DGY with DGY edges).
y=152..192 x=0..320.tile_grid: 40 cols x 5 rows = 200 cells. After ed5a clear all 200 cells = (0x20, 3). Then dfb9 overwrites specific cells with menu option labels at attr=3 (still wfont3, panel-variant).

y=192..200 x=0..320.tile_grid: 40 cells. c497-refreshed but no text written by wbase state 4. Whatever winit state 2 left in the cells.

wfont3_uppercase_alphabet_0x41_0x5A.top_bot_edges: DGY (continuous with bg — appears as solid gray bordered panel cell)

wfont3_lowercase_alphabet_0x61_0x7A.top_bot_edges: BLK (row 0 and row 7 of each 8x8 cell are all-BLK -> 1-pixel separator effect at top + bottom of each row when tiles are placed side-by-side)
wfont3_lowercase_alphabet_0x61_0x7A.usage: banner window text via c61a with attr=0x12 (which becomes puts attr=3 + lowercase source string)

wfont3_slot_0x20_space.usage: Lower pane background — ed5a(menu_text, 0x20, 3, 0) blits this to every cell. THIS IS THE 'NEUTRAL GRAY MENU PANE'.

wfont3_slot_0x5F_banner_space_or_undersc.format: 8x8 tile: row 0 all-BLK, rows 1..6 all-DGY, row 7 all-BLK
wfont3_slot_0x5F_banner_space_or_undersc.usage: Likely the 'banner space' fill — visually a horizontal gray band with 1-px black borders top+bot. Probably used to fill banner-row cells outside the centered text.

wfont3_slot_0x7F_banner_bat.usage: Bat icon — banner-style (BLK top+bot rows). Wraps the centered banner text.

wfont3_slots_0x11_0x15_panel_arrows_or_k.usage: CYN-bordered shortcut/arrow indicator tiles (e.g., LEFT/RIGHT/UP/DOWN/KEY icons inside a cyan-outlined box)

wfont3_slots_0x1C_0x1F_panel_box_drawing.usage: Bar/line tiles for borders (1c=horizontal bar, 1d=left-margin bar, 1e=top edge bar, 1f=top-left corner extension)

panel_vs_banner_variant_pattern.shape_equivalence_proof: Verified for slot pairs (0x41,0x61), (0x4D,0x6D), (0x42,0x62), (0x5A,0x7A) by comparing foreground bit patterns — all MATCH. Only the per-pixel colors differ.

other_fonts_summary.wfont0_1bpp_BLU_only: 128 1bpp glyphs, all BLU-on-BLK. Contains digits/letters/symbols/decorative chars. NOT used by main UI's text dispatch (slot 1 = 4bpp). Used by ega.drv slot 0 (text 1bpp at 0x19a) — possibly debug-print or some specialized renderer.
other_fonts_summary.wfont1_4bpp: Mix of box-drawing border tiles (0x00..0x1F: horizontal bars, vertical bars, T-junctions, corners — used for window FRAME borders like party_left's heavy 1B/1C border) + decorative iconography in upper half (shields, weapons, magical symbols). Alphabet slots 0x41..0x5A contain texture/fill patterns (NOT letter shapes). Likely selected by attr=1.
other_fonts_summary.wfont2_4bpp: More frame/border tiles + portrait fragments. Many empty slots (0x29..0x44, 0x63..0x7F). Letter slots have decorative content rather than letterforms. Likely selected by attr=2 for specialty windows (combat / character sheet?).
other_fonts_summary.wfont3_4bpp: THE MAIN UI ALPHABET FONT. Two-variant panel/banner letter sets + digits + punctuation + arrow icons + bat icon. Selected by attr=3.
other_fonts_summary.wfont4_4bpp: Decorative sprite tiles: treasure chests, weapons, armor icons, character class symbols. Alphabet slots have decorative content. Slots 0x67..0x7F are uniform DGY fill (likely backgrounds for class-icon overlays). Selected by attr=4. No clear panel/banner letter pair — wfont4 appears to be an ICON font, not a TEXT font.

load_path_verification.evidence: Disassembly of wroot 0x21bb..0x2217 shows the dec-ax/jz cascade selecting one of 5 segments based on font_index.
load_path_verification.ega_drv_propagation: The segment values at [wroot:cs:0x1b64..0x1b74] must be propagated to [ega.drv:cs:0x155..0x165] at driver init. Static .drv bytes at those offsets are LUT bytes (placeholders); the patch happens at driver load time. Not directly traced but inferred from the dispatch chain working end-to-end.

msg_string_case_hypothesis.claim: msg.dbs ID 0x3E9 ('MASTER OPTIONS' banner text) is encoded as LOWERCASE 'master options'. The engine renders it verbatim into the banner window's cells via c61a (which calls puts with attr=3 because attr-0xF=3). Lowercase ASCII codes 0x61..0x7A land on wfont3's banner-variant glyph slots, giving the LBL-on-BLK letterforms with 1-px BLK top/bot separator edges.
msg_string_case_hypothesis.evidence: c61a (wroot 0xb7e) does NO case transform; puts (wroot 0x251d) does NO case transform; putchar (wroot 0x23e3) stores byte verbatim into cell. Therefore the visual case selection is purely determined by the source string's byte values.
msg_string_case_hypothesis.verification_needed: Decode msg.dbs ID 0x3E9 to confirm it contains lowercase 'master options'. This requires running through the huffman decoder for msg.dbs (msg IDs 1000+ are outside the currently-extracted 0..717 range).

open_questions: EXACT initialization of ega.drv [cs:0x155..0x165] font segments — we infer wroot 0x1b64..0x1b74 segments are copied into those slots at driver load, but the patch code path wasn't directly traced. The static .drv bytes at 0x155+ are LUT placeholders.
msg.dbs IDs 1000+ (incl. 0x3E9 banner, 0x3EA..0x3F2 menu options) need decoding to verify the case-hypothesis. Currently extracted msg range stops at 717.
wfont0 (1bpp) usage in the live UI — appears unused by main menu but may be used elsewhere. ega.drv slot 0 (0x19a) IS the wfont0 dispatch but we haven't traced what calls it.
Highlight path via [cs:0x1b8a]: when wroot 0x22b7 (df85 putchar) shifts attr into high nibble, blit takes the [cs:0x1b8a] dispatch (not slot 1). What ega.drv slot is that? Needs further RE.
How banner cells OUTSIDE the centered text are filled. Hypothesis: implicit fill with 0x5F-attr-3 (banner space) somewhere in winit state 2 init or in c61a's prelude. Need to trace.

party_left/right (attr=0x06, 0x07) — these attrs are >4 in the low nibble, which would trigger the blit abort path. Unless the high nibble flag changes behavior, or these windows use a different draw path entirely. Need to verify by single-stepping the blit on a party_left cell.
implications_for_port: Asset pipeline: each wfont*.ega should be decoded into 128 8x8 RGBA tile images at boot. wfont3 specifically becomes 128 separately-colored tiles; the port should NOT attempt to use wfont3 as a 'monochrome font that gets recolored at render time' — every tile is fully pre-painted.

Window data structure: every tile-mode window is a 2D array of (tile_index, font_select) cells. The renderer walks this grid and draws the corresponding wfont tile at each (x_cell*8, y_cell*8) position. No transparency. No fg/bg compositing.
Pixel-mode windows (gate, top_title, full_bg) use a separate code path: composite raw PIC sprites pixel-by-pixel. No tile grid involvement.

Text rendering API: `puts(window, str, font_select)` where font_select in 1..4 selects which wfont — and the source STRING determines color variant via case (uppercase = panel-variant on wfont3, lowercase = banner-variant). To render 'MASTER OPTIONS' in banner style, pass the lowercase string 'master options' to wfont3.
ui_window_clear is JUST a memset of (char, attr) — does not draw immediately. Drawing happens at the next screen refresh.

The 'attr byte' is misnamed for our mental model — it's a FONT SELECTOR (1..4 = wfont1..wfont4), not a CGA/EGA text-mode (fg|bg<<4) attribute. The high nibble may select an alternate render mode (highlight, etc.) for some primitives.

WIZ6_PALETTE_1 (per palette-discovery.md) is the active palette during state 4. The color indices baked into the wfont tiles render under this palette. Index 8 (DGY) and index 9 (LBL) and index 1 (BLU) are the workhorse menu colors.
